entities.name: Query protein (341 aa)
observations: Sequence is 341 aa; estimated molecular mass 37.57 kDa and theoretical pI 5.11.
Strong homology to reviewed aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenases: best reference Q56734 has 65.0% identity and 98.8% query coverage.
Function inferred from reviewed homologs: NADPH-dependent reductive dephosphorylation of L-aspartyl-4-phosphate to L-aspartate-4-semialdehyde; EC 1.2.1.11.
Homolog annotations place this activity in lysine, methionine, and threonine biosynthesis; catalytic annotation for this query remains homology-based.

entities.name: RHEA:24284
observations: Aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase reaction: L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde + phosphate + NADP(+) = 4-phospho-L-aspartate + NADPH + H(+), as reported by homolog annotations.
